scenarios.title: CLE @ POR, 1 Feb 2026: Avdija out (trade, CLV +7.5c)
scenarios.summary: Portland's Deni Avdija is ruled out. The model shifts Portland's chance down, the agent buys POR 'no' at 55c and the close at 62.5c grades it +7.5c of closing-line value.

scenarios.title: Planted fault: future news citation (checks -> retry -> pass)
scenarios.summary: A fault injected for the demo makes the investigator cite news published after the decision. The checks reject it, the graph loops back once, and the clean retry passes.

scenarios.title: Planted violation: 'lock' wording (blocked)
scenarios.summary: The brief says 'This one is a lock.' on every try. Checks fail twice, the order is blocked and logged.

scenarios.title: Kill switch tripped (risk blocks)
scenarios.summary: Same trade, but the day's realised losses already exceeded the limit: the risk node blocks every order.

scenarios.title: MIL @ BOS: pass (priced in)
scenarios.summary: No edge after fees: the agent writes a brief and places nothing. Passing is a decision.

scenarios.title: POR @ UTA: learned rule r023 vetoes a trade
scenarios.summary: The gap clears the threshold but a rule the reviewer learned and the gate accepted (valid from before this decision) says skip.

scenarios.title: IND @ BKN: priced-in sceptic rejects (stub LLM)
scenarios.summary: The analyst finds an edge, code validates it, and the sceptic rejects because the price already moved.
